notes: Source: the managing company Meitav Gemel and Pension Ltd (מיטב גמל ופנסיה בע"מ) own report, from the company website (meitav.co.il, page "דוחות קרנות הפנסיה", section "דוח כספי - חברה מנהלת"; file served from mrkmd.meitav.co.il/media/reports/). The company does not report on MAYA (MAYA reports under reporter 1064 are the listed parent Meitav Investment House). The listed parent was not used.
Amounts in NIS thousands as printed (members = count; fee rates = percent). Negative values printed in parentheses are kept negative; a dash or empty cell is not recorded.

Per-fund-type tables (directors' report / description of the business, section "נתונים אודות פעילות בתחום קופות הגמל וקרנות הפנסיה"): segment pension_new = new pension funds, comprehensive (מקיפה) and general (כללית) as separate columns (fund_type); provident = personal gemel for compensation and severance, study funds, investment gemel, child-savings gemel and "other" central funds (fund_type); total = column "סך הכל" (pension + provident). sub = population (active / inactive / recipients = pensioners / total / active_and_inactive). No aggregate across columns was calculated.

Column identity was checked on every table page against the printed column headers. Additive rows were checked: the "סך הכל" column equals the sum of the seven fund-type columns, except rounding differences of 1 (thousand NIS) in the printed AUM active/inactive total rows of the 30.06.2025 table (Q2-2025 and Q2-2026 reports), the 30.09.2025 table (Q3-2025 report) and the 31.12.2023 table (FY2025 report), and differences in the pension-recipient counts of the 31.03.2026 table (total 18 vs sum 17; disability 1,756 vs 1,782); all kept exactly as printed.

Flow and fee windows are cumulative from 1 January: q in Q1, ytd in Q2/Q3 (six / nine months), fy in annual reports and for the year-end comparative. Q2 stand-alone flows are not printed in the interim reports (only the six-month and nine-month columns).

Segment note (ביאור מגזרי פעילות): provident = מגזר הגמל, pension = מגזר הפנסיה (new pension funds only), total = whole company; the column "לא מיוחס למגזרי פעילות" (unallocated investment gains / finance items) is not recorded as a segment but is included in the total column.

selling_and_marketing_expenses = "עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות" as printed: acquisition commissions net of capitalised deferred acquisition costs plus current amortisation of deferred acquisition costs (dac_amortisation). general_and_administrative_expenses = "הוצאות הנהלה וכלליות" as printed (net of amounts classified to commissions).

Meitav pays a management fee to its controlling company (דמי ניהול לחברה בעלת שליטה); it is a separate expense line, recorded as management_fees_to_controlling_company, and is not part of selling_and_marketing_expenses or general_and_administrative_expenses.

From the 2025 reports the income statement prints investment gains and finance income as one line ("רווחים מהשקעות, נטו והכנסות מימון"); it is recorded as investment_gains_and_finance_income (the 2023-2024 files carry investment_gains and finance_income separately). The 2025 reports also reclassify some comparative lines (total revenue, finance expenses of 2023-2024 differ from the figures printed in the 2024 annual report); each file carries the figures as printed in that report.

Payments to pensioners, actuarial surplus, surplus of income over expenses, the dormant-accounts tables, the direct-expense-rate tables and the track-level (per-fund) rows of notes 13 and 14a are printed but not recorded (outside the v7 metric list); the pensioner count and AUM totals ("סה"כ מקבלי קצבה") are recorded as sub = recipients.

Interim reports print three table sets in the directors' report: the current period (cumulative from 1 January), the same date of the prior year, and the full prior year-end. All are recorded, each with its own date.

Keys beyond the 2024 files: doc = which document of the PDF the page belongs to (board = directors' report, fs = financial statements, biz = description of the business, annual report only), table = table name, component = row component.
